Subject: POC trial planning - success criteria & next steps

Thanks for the time today — great discussion. Per our call, I wanted to capture the agreed success criteria, a proposed evaluation plan, and the initial RACI we discussed so we can lock timelines. Please confirm or flag changes by EOD Friday.

High-level POC goal
- Validate Redwood inference integration for triage workflows with 95th-pct latency < 300ms and per-token cost target <= $0.0008 for peak volumes.

Success criteria (customer-confirmed)
- Accuracy/clinical appropriateness: top-1 guidance match to clinician review >= 88% on the provided test set.
- Latency: 95th pct < 300ms for 512-token seqs for 90% of requests.
- Reliability: no more than 1% error rate over a 7-day window at expected load.
- Integration: app can call the Redwood API and receive structured JSON output (fields: suggestion, confidence, supporting_context).

Evaluation plan
1) Week 0 (this week): onboarding + model selection + infra checklist.
2) Week 1-2: connect test environment, run synthetic load and baseline metrics.
3) Week 3: run live sample set (de-identified) against the model, collect clinical review feedback.
4) Week 4: finalize evaluation report & go/no-go decision.

Proposed timeline (flexible)
- Kickoff: Mar 29
- Integration complete (app->Redwood): Apr 5
- Live sampling and review: Apr 6-12
- Final report: Apr 15

RACI (first pass) — items below need confirmation for ownership:
- Infra (VPC / network / firewall rules): Evergreen infra owner?
- App integration (API wiring, parsing responses): Evergreen app team
- Security/compliance sign-off: Evergreen security (SOC 2 evidence review) + Redwood support
- Procurement / SOW: Evergreen procurement + Redwood sales (Aditya)

Attachments: POC-MAP-2026-03.pdf (walkthrough + checklist).

Asks: Please reply with the point people for Infra, Security, and Procurement so we can add them to the RACI and invite them to the kickoff.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
